entities.name: Methoxypyridine substrate
observations: Contains an aryl methyl ether on a pyridine ring.

entities.name: Pyridone product
observations: Corresponds to the 2-pyridone/lactam tautomer of the demethylated pyridine substrate.

entities.name: Methoxy-pyridine demethylation
observations: Transformation cleaves the aryl O–CH3 bond, retains the aryl C–O bond, forms C=O, and protonates pyridine nitrogen to give the 2-pyridone tautomer.
Reported components include HBr, acetic acid, ammonium hydroxide, and water; ammonium hydroxide is likely workup or neutralization.

entities.name: HBr acidic demethylation conditions
observations: Hydrogen bromide, particularly in aqueous or acetic-acid medium, is a plausible reagent for cleaving the aryl methyl ether.
HI is a chemically analogous alternative; aqueous acid/base workup can establish the pyridone tautomer.
No reliable yield, time, or temperature was returned for the matching record.
